answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by tying trading rights to a proven history of useful work rather than to a free account. Like a gardener who must tend one orchard season after season before earning trust, an agent builds reputation only through attested deliveries that cannot be copied by spawning clones. New identities may wander in freely, but they start on a small knoll of limited credit and must earn higher limits step by step, so creating thousands of fake agents gains no market power.
